name: Agent-Reach
description: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — one CLI, zero API fees.
one_liner: A toolkit that lets an AI coding assistant read and search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, and other sites on your behalf, without paying for each site's official API.
buyer: A solo AI-agent developer who wants their assistant to research social media without paying for expensive official APIs (like Twitter's).
business_use_cases: A market researcher builds a cheap social-listening tool that tracks brand mentions across Twitter, Reddit, and YouTube for small clients.
A trend-newsletter writer automates weekly research across multiple platforms instead of manually browsing each one.
An indie developer bolts it onto a chatbot so it can answer questions using live web and social content.

money_ideas.idea: Build and sell a social-listening dashboard for small brands using this as the data-collection backend.

steal_this: Not a great foundation for a client-facing business as-is — it works by routing around platforms' official paid APIs and login walls, which is a real legal and stability risk if you build a paying business on top of it.
